about_the_game:
The complete original soundtrack for Decide 4 God, composed by Alec Shea.

Experience the dark electronic chaos that accompanies you throughout Decide 4 God!

"Six intruders and six captives share a high-tech prison where their moral dilemmas may lead them to a fate worse than death. Can they overcome the wiles of Empathy Systems? What dark secrets lurk behind that institution? When does knowledge become a curse?"

Tracklist:

1. Deforge

2. Decide 4 God

3. Decorum For Gossip

4. Deception Forgathered

5. Depleted Foreground

6. Decadence Foregone

7. Dementia Foregone

8. Determined For Goal

9. Defunct Forgery

10. Defiantly Forging

11. Debating For Gold

12. Delirium Forged

13. Deranged Forgiver

14. Devious Forage

15. Denatured For Genocide

16. Demonized For Gospel

17. Death Forgotten

18. Dead Forgiven

19. Denial For Grief

20. Daydream For Gutting

21. Dealing For Gain

22. Depressed For Garden

23. Detached For Growth

24. Deified Forgetfulness

25. Your Time Is Spent (bonus track)

26. Lepsog Rof Dezinomed (bonus track)
